changes.text: 另一种做法（作者设想的替代方案，不是史实）：只比较各区的平均死亡率，或者拿富区和穷区对比。那样贫富、住房、职业都会混进来，水的作用就分不清了。斯诺实际走的是更费事的路：他亲自查了兰贝斯公司供水所及各区的每一例霍乱死亡，挨家查住址、查水，必要时装瓶回家化验。部分只由南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水的地区（如伯蒙德西等），则由怀廷医生调查疫情头四周；其中部分分区后三周的数字，是按头四周的比例推算的。这样换来了两样东西。一是同一批混供街道里，按供水分开的死亡户数。二是按两家公司全部供水户计算的每万户死亡比较。

Another approach, and this is the author's counterfactual rather than history, would have been to compare average death rates by district, or rich districts against poor ones. Wealth, housing and occupation would then have crowded in, and the effect of the water would have been hard to separate out. What Snow actually did was more laborious. He inquired himself into every cholera death in the districts the Lambeth Company supplied: death addresses, house by house, and water carried home in phials. Some districts supplied only by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company, such as Bermondsey, were covered for the first four weeks by a medical man, Mr Whiting. In some of those sub-districts the figures for the last three weeks were calculated in the same proportion as in the first four weeks. This yielded two things. One was counts of deaths by water supply for houses in the same intermixed streets. The other was a company-wide comparison per 10,000 houses.

dispositions.rationale: 原文把只由南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水的地区一律归给怀廷调查，范围说大了。现收窄为“部分这类地区（如伯蒙德西等）”，并补上他只调查了疫情头四周这一限定。推算后三周数字的说法也收窄为按头四周比例推算。中英文同步修改，ev 补入 W-E19。

evidence.quote: to make inquiry in Bermondsey, Botherhithe, Wandsworth, and certain other districts, which are supplied only by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company
Mr. Whiting’s part of the investigation extended over the first four weeks of the epidemic, from 8th July to 5th August
the water supply of the last three weeks is calculated to have been in the same proportion by the Company, or by pump wells, etc., as in the first four weeks

dispositions.rationale: 已对照新补入的 W-E18 和 W-E19 复核全文。story.6、limits.0、limits.2 和 uncertainty_note 已交代以下几点：部分数字是推算的，怀廷只调查了头四周，14周数字含分摊并使用估计人口。剩下的缺口在 analysis.1：它扩大了怀廷的调查范围，又没有写明头四周的时限。本次已修正这一段，并在 ev 中补入 W-E19，使叙事与证据一致。

evidence.quote: Mr. Whiting’s part of the investigation extended over the first four weeks of the epidemic
the inquiry of Mr. Whiting having extended only to 5th August
